description: Source code for KafkaBatchPartitionReader and KafkaBatchInputPartition classes, implementing batch and micro-batch Kafka data reading in Spark Structured Streaming.

classes.name: KafkaBatchInputPartition
classes.description: InputPartition implementation for reading Kafka data in batch streaming queries.

classes.name: KafkaBatchReaderFactory
classes.description: Factory object for creating KafkaBatchPartitionReader instances.

classes.name: KafkaBatchPartitionReader
classes.description: PartitionReader for reading Kafka data in batch/micro-batch streaming queries, supporting real-time read features.

methods.name: preferredLocations
methods.description: Returns preferred locations for the input partition based on Kafka partition locality.

methods.name: createReader
methods.description: Creates a PartitionReader for a given InputPartition.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Advances to the next record, returning true if successful.

methods.name: nextWithTimeout
methods.description: Fetches the next record with a timeout, returning a RecordStatus.

methods.name: getOffset
methods.description: Returns the current offset of the partition.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Releases resources and closes the consumer.

methods.name: resolveRange
methods.description: Resolves Kafka offset range, late binding if offsets are negative.

methods.name: currentMetricsValues
methods.description: Returns current metrics such as offset out of range and data loss.
